verdict.rationale: Better Stack's AI SRE page claims an automated post-mortem generated from the incident timeline and Slack conversation. That covers the core of the story, but it rests on a single marketing line with no detail on what the output contains. The AI-suggested Linear tickets for root-cause fixes are an adjacent feature, not proof that the postmortem itself includes follow-ups. Missing for 10: documented coverage of contributing factors and follow-up items within the postmortem, an explicit draft-for-human-review workflow, in-depth docs on the feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
